target_customer: Brands and marketing teams, including Fortune 100 companies, buying social listening and analytics
problem: Brands could not cut through noisy social media data to find the conversations about them that mattered.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscriptions for social analytics

technical_complexity.rationale: Ingesting and ranking social data at scale and a custom query language (Fizzle) is standard big data engineering with some hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Social data was available through shared APIs and many vendors; the matching language and ranking were the only differentiators.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Not copied by a single incumbent; DataRank was bought by Simply Measured in October 2015 for undisclosed terms.

market_need_then: Brands were adopting social media monitoring and spending on social analytics; TechCrunch positioned DataRank against Radian6 by how it prioritizes data.

branding.domain_note: Used datarank.com; the domain now redirects to Sprout Social after acquisitions.
branding.community_and_virality: Company says it kept an active blog and social presence; no outside coverage of the brand found.

brand_strength.rationale: A descriptive name in a crowded category with little outside brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: DataRank sold social listening against larger players such as Radian6, raised about $1.4M in early 2014 and was folded into Simply Measured in October 2015, which bought it as its second acquisition that autumn. Terms were undisclosed and the product was absorbed, so this is a small exit rather than a breakout, in a crowded category with limited defensibility.
notes: The YC page lists two founders; search results say a third founder, Chuong Nguyen, was part of the company, not listed here because no opened company source confirms it. Founded October 2011 per search coverage. CB Insights lists $2.15M over 9 rounds and GeekWire says $1.6M raised, so rounds beyond the 2014 seed are not itemized. Education and prior employers not found. datarank.com now redirects to sproutsocial.com. The YC directory lists Seattle and Fayetteville locations; DataRank itself was in Fayetteville, Arkansas per Talk Business.
